applies_to: R-SG3 in the Series R I/O manual MI-00604-29-EN.
summary: The R-SG3 is a Seneca R-series converter for 4- or 6-wire strain-gauge load cells with two digital outputs. It serves Modbus TCP on one Ethernet port and Modbus RTU as a slave. This map covers net/gross/tare weight, status, the command register used for tare and calibration, thresholds and filter setup.

addressing.note: The R-SG3 table prints the 4x number (40001) and a 0-based offset (0) on every row; the manual's numbering chapter says the offset is the 0-based address to put on the wire.

source.title: Series R I/O with protocol - User Manual
source.pages: R-SG3 description p. 15; DIP switches p. 24; Modbus conventions pp. 95-100; R-SG3 table pp. 180-197; calibration via Modbus p. 213

notes: Every 32-bit row in the R-SG3 table marks the first register MSW and the second LSW, so the map uses ABCD.
Weight values are IEEE floats in the unit chosen at 40003.

Left out: the signed 32-bit integer weights (40070-40075), because the manual does not say how they are scaled; the analog output settings 40005 and 40022-40029, which apply to the Z-SG3 / ZE-SG3 only; the digital input register 40006, whose text is cut off in the table; reserved and password registers.
Factory settings in the R-SG3 web-server chapter: static IP 192.168.90.101, Modbus TCP port 502, RTU station address 1, 38400 baud, no parity, 1 stop bit (data bits are not listed for this model).
RW* registers live in flash and tolerate about 10,000 writes.
Left out: the raw 24-bit ADC readings (40092-40095), which are typed unsigned 32-bit but carry no MSW/LSW marking.

integration.summary: Poll net weight (63) and status (77); bit 4 of status says the weight is stable. Tare and calibration are done by writing codes to the command register at 79.
integration.enable: Modbus TCP and RTU are active by default; network settings are changed in the web server or Seneca's discovery tool. DIP switches 1-2 select normal operation, factory reset or web server disabled.
quirks: Bits 5-6 of the status register only drive the outputs when the output mode is 'from Modbus' (40033).
setup: Factory IP is 192.168.90.101; change it before adding a second unit.
Field tare: write 49914 to the command register with the empty platform loaded.
gotchas: Tare taken with code 49594 lives in RAM and is lost at reboot; use 49914 to store it in flash.
Output mode codes in 40033 bits 8-11 (DO1) and 12-15 (DO2): 0 full scale, 1 threshold, 2 stable weight, 3 from Modbus, 4 threshold with hysteresis.
Filter level 7 hands control to the advanced filter registers.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
